question: For the accepted one-aircraft B01 preparation lasting 0.5 hour, does shortening only MissionType.NOPER from 1 to exactly 0.5 hour let the preparation complete at the scheduled h8 launch boundary while the mission still starts at h8?

accepted_parent.accepted_behavior: one h8–10 successful mission, notice/allocation/preparation start h7, 0.5-hour preparation completes h7.5, 72 System and 72 Stock half-hour rows, one successful mission; 11 raw files bound by closure

manual.interpretation: MissionType.NOPER begins allocation before STIM and should normally cover pre-mission preparation. MissionPreparation.DURN must be less than or equal to NOPER and work occurs in that notice period; the proposed DURN0.5 equals NOPER0.5. DTIM remains 1/3 hour. Equality of completion and scheduled launch is a specific event-order question, not a general guarantee.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: MissionType.NOPER 1 to 0.5 hour among 167 authored cells
source_delta.retained: MissionPreparation.DURN0.5, task mapping, STIM8, fixed DURN2, DTIM1/3, one aircraft, seed1, horizon36, 0.5-hour collection and all other cells

predeclared_acceptance: Independent contract review must pin accepted B01 source, evidence, independent verdict, closure and all 11 local raw files, plus accepted A01 source/index and 34 local raw files. No accepted native run may be repeated.

Freeze an exact one-cell parent diff, negative control proving parent preparation starts h7 rather than proposed h7.5, exact authored-table roundtrip checker, complete behavior validator and a unique SSH0 runner. Obtain independent static prelaunch GO bound to exact SHA before native.

Require actual SSH0/sshd ancestry, free Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, absent unique run directory, no second native process, responsive GUI actual PID/session/exact start, stable source SHA before/after, and preserved failed bytes on any error.

Native import/export must retain the one NOPER0.5 value and all authored populated tables. Converter errors must be zero and warnings classified. A converter rejection or short output is NO_GO; do not infer physical behavior from it.

For valid calculation require notice and allocation at h7.5, physical aircraft0 preparation start h7.5 and end h8, mission launch h8 without cancellation or delay, task and h10 success/return on the same identity. Exact h8 event order must be reported; do not claim it generalizes to other same-time boundaries.

Require complete 72×40 System, 72×16 Stock, 11 ResultSummary and ProblemDescription fields. Stock, summary, physical flight2h and terminal ready1 must match accepted B01. Reconcile every System field and 0.5-hour interval against the h7.5–8 preparation and h8–10 flight ledger; any unexpected output is NO_GO, with no postrun relaxation.

A separately authored read-only replay must check source/raw SHA and size pins, exact event identity/order and every report field without importing the author validator. Bounded signoff, independent staged/remote review and authorized simlox/main PR/merge are required for publication.
limits: One fixed seed, one preparation task, one aircraft and exact-equality NOPER boundary only; insufficient notice arm, resource shortages, other B01.var02 variants, GUI visual, cross-engine and performance remain unverified.
